ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels localized at the peduncle junction and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling clustered at the central peduncle-fluke interface; mid-intensity gray gradients across the interior lobes; dominant dark pixels occupy the central and inner lateral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 68 degrees and a pixel depth of roughly 12% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 4-15 pixels, with the most pronounced jagged topography on the distal image-right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the outer margins leading to heavily textured, rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters concentrated heavily at the base of the fluke and sporadically along the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct unaligned linear pixel disruptions; includes three parallel vertical dark streaks on the image-right lobe and several diagonal dark rakes on the image-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white-colored trauma/scarring at the central peduncle attachment point and irregular, thickened texture at the lobe tips likely corresponding to persistent parasite attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced nodular protrusions at the distal tips of both lobes creating a non-uniform pixel density at the fluke extremities.
